div.div:
Section: Projects
The Projects section holds a set of stacked Card objects representing a collection of projects. Each Card is a link to a new page relating to that specific Card. Cards will contain the project title and a project summary. Cards might contain images or graphics.
Cards will come in and out of view as we move up or down the page. Their functionality will be in the Card object.
Layout:
Cards should span the width unless on larger screens where they will have a set width.

div.div:
Header: Navigation
The Navigation Header will contain the site / title, the current page title, & a dropdown menu for quick navigation.
Value Changes:
Things that will change when we change directories.
1. Page Title.
2. Site Icon -> might change to a back arrow and text.
3. Menu might change highlights.
Input:
Moving down the page will show the header disappearing, while moving up the page it will suddenly appear. This is for easier use on mobile applications.

div.div:
Card: Component
Cards will be flexible in the height and width with maximum and minimum values set in the section element. It will have the ability to route to its respective project page.
Contain:
1. "Project Title" located at the top left of Card
2. Project summary.
3. Optional image
4. Optional quick links.
Actions:
- hover : Card will appear to pop out of the page slightly. (optional: accordion to display more information.)
- click : Card will update to linked routing.
